final_text:
I found Lena Fischer and the Harbor Point Info shared mailbox. Before I set this up, what type of access should Lena have?

**Option 1: Full Read Access** - Can read and manage emails but cannot send as the mailbox
**Option 2: Full Read Access + Send As** - Can read emails and send as the info mailbox (emails appear to come from info@harborpointdental.test)
**Option 3: Full Read Access + Send on Behalf** - Can read emails and send on behalf of the info mailbox (emails show "on behalf of Harbor Point Info")
**Option 4: Full Permissions** - All three (Read + Send As + Send on Behalf)
